拖曳旋轉模型。畫面停下來時，瀏覽器會讀一次目前的畫面，告訴你這個角度掃得到哪個連: Drag to rotate the model. When the view stops, the browser reads the current frame and tells you which link scans from this angle. Silhouette sculptures are generated live from any links, and you can compare connection methods.
徽章樣式：白色圖案在深色底上（建議；全白的列會讓 QR 整列無法覆蓋）: Badge style: white motif on a dark field (recommended; an all-white row leaves a whole QR row uncovered)
側面剪影會長這樣（深色＝有材料）。: The side silhouette will look like this (dark = material).

單一材質印出來的樣子，顏色可以自己選；掃描時仍要背光看剪影。: How a single-material print looks, in the colour you choose; scanning still needs the backlit silhouette.
深淺顛倒：深色線材比淺色亮，多數掃描器讀不到反相的 QR。: Inverted: the dark filament is lighter than the light one; most scanners cannot read inverted QR codes.
對比 {r}:1，偏低，掃描器可能讀不到。: Contrast {r}:1 is low; scanners may fail.
定位圖案顏色和模型不同時，就是雙材質列印；形狀不變，所以仍然保證可解碼。: A finder colour different from the model means a two-material print; the shape is unchanged, so decoding stays certified.
圓角方塊的面中央仍然互相接觸，可以印成一件。: Rounded cubes still touch across the middle of their faces, so they print as one piece.
圓柱和球之間只有線或點接觸，只適合封在透明材料裡；剪影會變成圓點，定位圖案可能讀: Cylinders and spheres only touch along lines or points, so they suit clear encapsulation only; silhouettes turn into dots and finder patterns may stop reading.
上傳 Logo 圖檔（會轉成黑白格子）: Upload a logo image (turned into black and white modules)
預覽從上方看到的 QR，藍色是 Logo。Logo 改動的碼字會先從糾錯能力扣掉: Preview of the QR as seen from the top; the logo is blue. Codewords the logo changes are taken out of the error correction first and bridges only use what is left, so decoding stays certified.
Logo 太大：{view}的第 {b} 區塊要改動 {x} 個碼字，但只能更正: Logo too large: block {b} of the {view} view would change {x} codewords but can only correct {c}. Make the logo smaller, use Outline or Transparent, or pick a larger QR version.
剪影要在約 {m} m 外拍攝（視差限制和實際尺寸成正比）。: Shoot the silhouettes from about {m} m away (the parallax limit scales with the real size).
注意：網格有未封閉的邊，切片前請先修復。: Note: the mesh has open edges; repair it before slicing.
QR 剪影就是檢查可解碼保證時用的模組圖案，方向和畫面上看到的一樣；邊框是四周留: The silhouette QR is the module image the certificate checks, oriented as on screen; the border is the number of light modules around it (the QR standard recommends 4).
內容需要至少版本 {v}，請選更大的版本或改用自動。: The content needs at least version {v}; choose a larger version or Auto.
等級越低，QR 越小、格體越少，但能拿來橋接的容錯預算也越少。: A lower level gives a smaller QR and fewer cubes, but leaves less error budget for bridging.
用整顆格體把碎塊連起來，只在被定位圖案封住的地方加細支架: Whole cubes join the fragments; thin struts only where finder patterns seal pieces off
主體連成一塊；被封住的小碎塊會分開（數學上無法避免）: The main body is one piece; small sealed fragments stay separate (provably unavoidable)
刪掉多餘格體，全部用沿格線的細支架連起來: Remove redundant cubes and join everything with thin struts along grid lines
適合封在透明樹脂或雷射內雕水晶裡: For embedding in clear resin or laser-engraved crystal
對照組：所有合法位置都放格體，會碎成非常多塊: Baseline: a cube at every legal position, which breaks into a great many fragments
允許橋接壓過時序、分隔、校正圖案（未認證：碎塊更少，但只靠解碼器實測）: Let bridges cover timing, separator and alignment patterns (not certified: fewer fragments, checked only by decoders)
橋接格最多能用掉多少 QR 糾錯能力。剩下的留給相機雜訊；100% 時實測會讀不: How much of the QR error correction bridges may use. The rest is left for camera noise; at 100% real scanners fail.
可拖曳旋轉的 3D 模型: 3D model you can drag to rotate
不停地垂直繞圈（經過上方與下方）；再按一次或拖曳畫面就停: Keep turning vertically through top and bottom; press again or drag to stop
不停地水平繞圈；再按一次或拖曳畫面就停: Keep turning horizontally; press again or drag to stop
不停地翻轉、看遍六個面；再按一次或拖曳畫面就停: Keep tumbling to show every face; press again or drag to stop
平放在桌上。從正上方看，讀到的是俯視的碼；站到北、東、南、西任一邊，往下斜 35: Lay it flat on a table. From straight above you read the top code; from the north, east, south or west side, looking down 35-50°, you read that side's code.
背光看剪影。上、前、側三個方向各一個碼（或 Logo），對面看到的是鏡像。需要把: View the silhouettes against a backlight. Top, front and side each carry a code (or a logo); the opposite side shows the mirror image. Pull the camera back and scan with a telephoto lens from several metres.
黑色剪影配白色背光，是掃描時真正看到的樣子。: Black silhouette on a white backlight: what a scanner actually sees.
三種顏色分別標出原本就合法的格體、橋接格與細支架。: The three colours mark cubes that were already legal, bridge cubes and thin struts.
最大的一塊用自己的顏色，其他每個分開的碎塊依色彩系列輪流上色。: The largest piece has its own colour; every other separate piece takes the next colour of the palette.
漸層只影響畫面；匯出的檔案仍是單色（用模型顏色）。: The gradient is for display only; exported files stay one colour (the model colour).
剩下的碎塊被定位圖案（或時序、校正圖案）的白色框封住。只用整顆格體、又不破壞這些: The remaining fragments are sealed inside the white rings of finder (or timing, alignment) patterns. With whole cubes only and those patterns intact, joining them is mathematically impossible; allow bridges to cover patterns to reduce fragments, or use cube bridging + fewest struts.
格體彼此不接觸，這種版本要嵌在透明材料裡（例如雙材質光固化、或雷射內雕水晶）。: The cubes do not touch, so this version must be embedded in a clear material (dual-material resin printing or laser-engraved crystal).
放寬模式會壓到時序／分隔／校正圖案，不在數學保證範圍內，請以旋轉解碼結果為準。: Relaxed mode covers timing, separator and alignment patterns, so it is outside the certificate; rely on the rotating decode results.
Logo 的白色像素擋住了部分 QR 模組。橋接方法會改用少量 Logo 像素來: The logo's white pixels block some QR modules. The bridging methods spend a few logo pixels instead, which usually lets both QR codes pass the certificate.
有連結太長，超過 QR 最高版本的容量。請改用短網址。: A link is too long for the largest QR version. Use a short URL.

QQR 目前是固定的示範模型，五個連結已經做在模型裡。要換成自己的連結，需要等: QQR is a fixed demo model for now: its five links are built in. Your own links need the QQR generator ported to the web.
蛋格是一片平放的板子：每個 QR 模組是一個開口的格子，格子四面牆各帶一個方向的: The egg-crate is a flat tile: every QR module is an open cell whose four walls each carry one direction's code and whose floor carries the top code, so one tile holds five codes.
從正上方讀俯視的碼；站到北、東、南、西任一邊，往下斜 35° 到 50° 讀那一: Read the top code from straight above; stand on the north, east, south or west side and look down 35-50° for that side's code. The demo model's structure cannot be changed.
背光剪影固定用白色背光，掃描才讀得到；其他顯示方式和蛋格會用這個背景。: Backlit silhouettes always use a white backlight so they scan; the other looks and the egg-crate use this backdrop.
